about: Curated map of the 135-question proofs/derivations bank to reusable solver engines. Assignments are a curator's judgement from the question text, figure flag and the bank's reasoning_methods; they are not solver output. feasibility = expected effort to reach SOLVED_AND_TRACE_CHECKED with SymPy/Newclid: high (mechanical check exists), medium (needs new parsing, branches or case handling), low (needs open-ended reasoning, constructions or a new proof system).

build_order.name: Symbolic core
build_order.rationale: One shared piece of work (safe parser with log/sqrt/symbols/vectors, a generic hypotheses-and-goal spec, elimination and exact-zero checks) serves eight engines. Mostly high-feasibility text-only questions.

build_order.name: Calculus
build_order.rationale: Reuses the phase 1 parser and spec; adds diff/limit/integrate with domain tracking.

build_order.name: Discrete and logic
build_order.rationale: Small, decidable checkers with high feasibility; independent of each other.

build_order.name: Trig extensions
build_order.rationale: Extend existing code: constrained identities, special angles, branches, discriminant.

build_order.name: Synthetic geometry
build_order.rationale: Largest group but highest cost per question: figure encoding, Newclid adapter gaps and school-style write-ups. Needs the interpretation stage for figures.

build_order.name: Open-ended
build_order.rationale: Lowest automation yield; likely LLM-drafted with human review.

trig_identity.title: Trigonometric identities
trig_identity.check: Permitted-rule rewrite search, exact equality, domain replay
trig_identity.gaps: Special-angle products that need the multiply-by-2-sin trick (e.g. sin 20° sin 40° sin 60° sin 80°). General solutions are implemented (mathcore/strategies/general.py).

inverse_trig_branch.title: Inverse trigonometric identities
inverse_trig_branch.check: Principal-branch interval tracking, then exact tan/cos evaluation
inverse_trig_branch.gaps: Branch conditions are proved for numbers and for one variable on a stated interval; several variables not yet

algebraic_identity.title: Exact algebraic, index, log and surd identities
algebraic_identity.check: Exact simplification of LHS - RHS with recorded domain (positivity for logs/indices)

constrained_relation.title: Relations under given conditions
constrained_relation.check: Eliminate hypotheses (substitution, Groebner basis or parametrisation) and reduce target to zero; record non-zero divisors
constrained_relation.gaps: Inequality givens; componendo–dividendo is implemented as a prescribed method (X-009)

polynomial_theorems.title: Factor theorem, completing the square, discriminant
polynomial_theorems.gaps: Higher-degree factorisation beyond the factor theorem

sequence_series.title: AP/GP term and sum relations
sequence_series.check: Substitute general term/sum formulas and simplify the claimed relation
sequence_series.gaps: XI-006 is solved by naming the larger number first (b + d, d >= 0)

factorial_binomial.title: Factorial and binomial-coefficient identities
factorial_binomial.check: Symbolic factorial ratios and general-term exponent matching
factorial_binomial.gaps: Products like 1.3.5...(2n-1) need a double-factorial encoding

complex_algebra.title: Complex-number identities
complex_algebra.check: Split into real/imaginary parts with real symbols; omega reduction via 1+w+w^2=0

differentiation.title: Derivatives, implicit differentiation, first principles, ODE verification
differentiation.check: SymPy diff/limit and substitution back into the stated relation, with domain
differentiation.gaps: Two curves at once (XII-020, orthogonal curves); first principles covers roots, products with trig and polynomials

extremum_monotonicity.title: Maxima/minima and monotonicity
extremum_monotonicity.check: Critical points, second-derivative or sign test on the stated domain
extremum_monotonicity.gaps: Exactly one critical point in the domain; closed-interval endpoint comparisons not yet

definite_integration.title: Definite integrals and areas
definite_integration.check: Exact integration, reflection property, region bounds
definite_integration.gaps: Antiderivatives from school substitutions and SymPy's step-by-step integrator; integration by parts not yet

determinant_matrix.title: Determinant and matrix identities
determinant_matrix.check: Symbolic determinant expansion and factor comparison; transpose algebra with noncommutative symbols
determinant_matrix.gaps: Students expect row/column operations, so the trace must record them

analytic_coordinate.title: Coordinate and 3D analytic geometry
analytic_coordinate.check: Distance, section, area and line formulas with exact arithmetic
analytic_coordinate.gaps: Not yet wired into this pipeline; symbolic-parameter coordinates

metric_geometry_coordinates.title: Length/area relations proved by Pythagoras
metric_geometry_coordinates.code: mathcore/parse.py (points, dist2/dot/cross/area), mathcore/figure.py (figure facts checked), mathcore/render.py
metric_geometry_coordinates.check: Symbolic coordinates with right angle at origin; identity in squared lengths
metric_geometry_coordinates.gaps: Answers use coordinates, not Pythagoras on named triangles

synthetic_geometry.title: Synthetic Euclidean proofs (congruence, circles, similarity, areas)
synthetic_geometry.check: Newclid proof plus independent symbolic-coordinate check of the conclusion
synthetic_geometry.gaps: Coordinate proofs cover lengths, midpoints, parallels, perpendiculars and areas. Not yet: angle equalities (bisectors), circles and arcs, congruence/similarity write-ups, constructions; Newclid has one reviewed encoding

boolean_membership.title: Set identities, logic and counterexamples
boolean_membership.check: Per-element membership truth tables (decides these quantifier-free set statements); finite counterexample search

probability_atoms.title: Probability from axioms
probability_atoms.check: Express events over Venn atoms with non-negative atom probabilities; linear/polynomial identity

relation_function.title: Relation and function properties
relation_function.check: Reflexive/symmetric/transitive by symbolic rewriting; injective/surjective by solving for preimages
relation_function.gaps: Geometric relation XII-008 needs counterexample by construction

induction.title: Mathematical induction
induction.check: Base case evaluation and symbolic step P(k) => P(k+1) (sum or divisibility quotient)

contradiction_inequality.title: Contradiction, irrationality and inequalities
contradiction_inequality.gaps: Sum of discriminants and 'only real solution' are implemented; irrationality and triangle inequalities are not
